window: Covering reporting published since the Sept 14 edition, roughly Sept 13-15, with several South American and Mexican incident dates running back to Sept 10-12 where reporting lagged. DEA's own press-release feed has posted nothing new since Sept 9 (already logged), so the federal section instead draws on DOJ U.S. Attorney's Office releases out of Arizona and New Jersey. A search for a possible new annual U.S. drug-certification 'majors list' turned out to be recirculated coverage of the September 2025 decision to decertify Colombia, not a new 2026 determination, so it was excluded. No new development surfaced on the SOUTHCOM boat-strike or refueling-vessel campaigns (nothing posted since the Sept 9 strike already logged), the Los Tiguerones case, Uruguay's Artigas airdrop case or Bolivia's aircraft-grounding crackdown, so the ongoing section is empty again.
